'''''Beautiful Young Minds''''' was a documentary first shown at the [[BRITDOC]] Festival on 26 July 2007<ref name="The Schedule (26 July 2007)">{{cite web|url=https://www.britdoc.org/festival/schedule.php|title=The Schedule|date=26 July 2007|website=[[The BRITDOC Foundation]]|access-date=5 July 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20061002202816/https://www.britdoc.org/festival/schedule.php|archive-date=2 October 2006|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref name="Watching Films (26 July 2007)">{{cite web|url=https://www.britdoc.org/festival/schedule.php|title=Watching Films|date=26 July 2007|website=The BRITDOC Foundation|access-date=5 July 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20061002202816/https://www.britdoc.org/festival/schedule.php|archive-date=2 October 2006|url-status=dead}}</ref> and first broadcast on [[BBC 2]] on 14 October 2007.<ref name="Kidult: Beautiful Young Minds (14 October 2007)">{{cite web|url=http://www.bbc.co.uk/programmes/b0084b18|title=Kidult: Beautiful Young Minds|date=14 October 2007|website=BBC.co.uk|publisher=BBC|access-date=5 July 2016}}</ref> The documentary follows the [[International Mathematical Olympiad selection process#United Kingdom|selection process]] and training for the U.K. team to compete in the 2006 [[International Mathematical Olympiad]] (IMO), as well as the actual event in Slovenia. Many of the young mathematicians featured in the film had a form of [[autism]], which the documentary links to mathematical ability. The team goes on to win numerous medals at the IMO, including four silver and one bronze. It was directed by [[Morgan Matthews (filmmaker)|Morgan Matthews]], edited by Joby Gee and featured music by Sam Hooper. It was also screened at the [[Bath Film Festival]] in October 2007. The documentary inspired the 2014 film ''[[X+Y]]'', which was also directed by Morgan Matthews, based on IMO participant [[Daniel Lightwing]].<ref name="The World of Asperger’s (28 August 2008)">{{cite web|url=http://www.abc.net.au/catalyst/stories/2346896.htm|title=The World of Asperger's|last=Newby|first=Dr Jonica|date=28 August 2008|website=ABC.net.au|publisher=Government of
